verdict.rationale: uv's docs publish an llms.txt index at docs.astral.sh/uv/llms.txt, and every docs page can be fetched as raw markdown by appending index.md, so an agent can be pointed at agent-friendly docs directly. The probe 404s checked different paths (the domain-root /llms.txt and /uv/.md), so they do not contradict the documented /uv/llms.txt location. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that /uv/llms.txt and the index.md variants resolve, and any agent-specific usage guidance beyond the llms.txt index.
